maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are positioned dorsally to the primary dense row, appearing in a staggered formation where each spot is centered approximately between the two spots immediately below it at a vertical offset of roughly 1-1.5 spot diameters.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The visible portion of the rhinarium apex exhibits approximately 98-100% melanin saturation, appearing as a uniform cluster of dark pixels with no visible pink or pale depigmentation.
